'''Rowralorr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who worked as a [[Weaponsmith|gunsmith]]<ref name="TJoY" /> at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''The Jewel of Yavin'' took place while Lando Calrissian was Baron Administrator of Cloud City, a period which started in 1 ABY and ended in 3 ABY according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During this period they lived on the floating [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], which was located in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. There, Rowralorr plied their trade selling [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry on [[Market Row]], a commercial corridor in the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rowralorr appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The Wookiee is listed as a merchant players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.<ref name="TJoY" />
